assumptions.choice: current price at each bar is approximated by that bar's Close (self.data.close[0])
assumptions.reason: the 1-minute OHLCV feed carries no sub-bar tick/quote data, so a literal instantaneous 'current price' does not exist; the bar's close is the closest available reading at evaluation time.

assumptions.choice: call self.broker.set_coc(True) in __init__ so market entry orders fill at the current bar's close instead of the next bar's open
assumptions.reason: the spec requires opening positions on the current candle 'rather than waiting for the bar to close'; backtrader's default next-bar-open fill would contradict that, and cheat-on-close is the closest literal mechanism available from within the strategy.

assumptions.choice: bt.indicators.CrossOver(self.data.close, self.data.close(-1)) compares each bar's close (current-price proxy) against the immediately preceding bar's close (previous candle's close) as two aligned series
assumptions.reason: detecting a 'cross' requires two time series; this is the direct construction from the stated inputs (current price vs. previous candle's close).

assumptions.choice: size = int(cash * 0.999 / price) at entry, i.e. essentially all available cash minus a small commission buffer
assumptions.reason: spec explicitly states fixed 100% of capital per trade; the 0.1% buffer avoids a cash/margin rejection from the stated commission.

assumptions.choice: implemented as native OCO Stop/Limit orders via buy_bracket/sell_bracket at entry time, which check every subsequent bar's High/Low, and remain live independent of the liquidity-window/open-buffer filters
assumptions.reason: SL/TP are risk controls meant to trigger the instant price touches the threshold, which native stop/limit order types capture more faithfully than only checking bar closes; the time filters are read as gating new trading signals, not withdrawing existing risk protection.

assumptions.choice: liquidity window fixed to 10:00-16:00 local (start inclusive, end exclusive) and session open fixed to 09:30 local for the 5-minute buffer, computed via integer minute-of-day arithmetic on self.data.datetime.datetime(0)
assumptions.reason: spec leaves exact boundary semantics unstated; these are the conventional US market-hours reading, and integer arithmetic avoids importing a module (datetime) outside the allowed import list.

assumptions.choice: on an opposite crossover while a position is open, explicitly cancel any still-pending stop/limit sibling order, then self.close()
assumptions.reason: the spec calls for closing the position on the opposite crossover signal, which must coexist cleanly with the standing SL/TP bracket without leaving orphaned pending orders.
